goal:
T44 — Arena engine: the same sealed task runs in two lanes at once, EvoForge vs a single AI, scored the same way.

Read docs/NORTH_STAR.md first. Build services/api/evoforge/arena.py and routes in services/api/main.py:
- POST /v1/arena {suite_version (v1|v2, default v2), task_id, model (default muse-spark-1.3)} -> 202 {arena_id,
  status:"running"}. Unknown task -> 404. Before any provider call run the budget guard for both lanes together
  (single: 1 call; evoforge: PIPELINE_MAX_ATTEMPTS calls; same per-call cents as the eval endpoints) -> 402.
- One background job (reuse services/api/evoforge/eval_jobs.py: one job at a time) runs both lanes concurrently
  (two threads) on the same task, same files, same goal:
  * lane "single" = what a single chat gives you: ONE Builder call, its diff applied strictly (harness
    api-sealed-eval/1 semantics: patch.apply_unified_diff(..., recount=False)), no Critic, no retry.
  * lane "evoforge" = the EvoForge pipeline for that task (harness api-sealed-eval/2, up to PIPELINE_MAX_ATTEMPTS
    attempts with failing-test-name feedback, same helpers as run_pipeline).
  * both lanes are scored by the task's sealed held-out tests in a fresh sandbox (same scorer as the evals).
- Each lane records: status, attempts, heldout {passed, n}, outcome (passed|empty_diff|apply_failed|heldout_failed),
  cost_cents (provider usage, like the evals), elapsed_ms, diff (the final candidate diff — the Builder's own output is
  fine to show), and events: [{seq, ts, role: "builder"|"critic"|"runner"|"gate", message}] in order.
- verdict {winner: "evoforge"|"single"|"tie", reason} from held-out results (more passed wins; equal -> tie).
- GET /v1/arena/{id} (404 unknown) and GET /v1/arena -> {arenas: [...]} newest first (<= 20). Store arenas in the
  evidence store (postgres_state.ScopedRecords("records"), kind "arena") so they survive redeploys.
- Never return held-out test code or the reference fix. Do not change patch.py semantics.
Tests: services/api/tests/test_muse_t44.py. Proxy: allow POST /v1/arena, GET /v1/arena, GET /v1/arena/<id> in
apps/web/lib/proxyPolicy.ts and proxyPolicy.cases.json.
